product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system for physiotherapy clinics that combines traditional clinical management features with AI assistance. It aims to optimize patient care, clinical documentation, and operational management by leveraging Google Gemini AI integration alongside a comprehensive set of clinical, scheduling, financial, and communication tools.
core_goals: Digitize and automate physiotherapy clinical processes to improve operational efficiency.
Enhance clinical documentation quality using AI-powered automation and suggestions.
Provide a user-friendly platform for clinic administrators, physiotherapists, interns, and patients with role-based access.
Facilitate personalized patient care with interactive clinical tools like body maps and treatment tracking.
Enable financial and inventory management to support clinic business operations.
Support teleconsultation and real-time communication through integrated systems.
Offer rich analytics and reporting for clinical performance and financial insights.
key_features: Comprehensive Patient Management with detailed medical history, electronic health records, and interactive body map for pain tracking.
Advanced Appointment Scheduling with weekly/daily calendar views, conflict prevention, recurring appointments, and notifications.
Rich Clinical Documentation (SOAP) editor with auto-save, version control, customizable templates, and AI-generated reports.
AI Integration via Google Gemini for generating physiotherapy reports, treatment protocol suggestions, risk analysis, clinical queries, and financial insights.
Extensive Exercise Library with categorization, multimedia support, personalized prescriptions, and contraindication alerts.
Secure Patient Portal for exercise tracking, appointment viewing and requests, history access, and clinic communication.
Financial Management including revenue tracking, payment processing with Stripe and PIX integration, invoicing, and delinquency control.
Teleconsultation enabled by Jitsi integration and session management for remote patient care.
Inventory and Supply Management with stock control, alerts, and historical tracking.
Comprehensive Dashboards and Analytics displaying operational, clinical, and financial metrics with interactive exportable reports.
User Management with role-based access, authentication, and user profile administration.
Real-time Notifications and task management system with reminders and alerts.
Backup and data recovery mechanisms ensuring data integrity and compliance.
user_flow_summary: Clinic Administrator logs in, manages users, oversees financials, reviews dashboards and reports.
Physiotherapists access patient data, manage clinical notes via rich editor, schedule and conduct teleconsultations, and prescribe exercises.
Interns view patient and scheduling information with limited access for learning purposes.
Patients securely log into their portal to view prescribed exercises, appointment details, clinical history, and communicate with the clinic.
Scheduling system ensures conflict-free appointments with recurrence and notification flows for all stakeholders.
AI assistant processes clinical data to generate reports, suggest treatments, and provide risk analysis accessible by clinicians.
Financial workflows include payment processing via Stripe or PIX, subscription management, and revenue tracking.
Inventory team manages clinical supplies with notifications for low stock and movement history.
Notifications and task management enable efficient communication and operation tracking across all user roles.
validation_criteria: System validates unique patient identifiers (e.g., CPF) and prevents duplicates.
Appointment scheduling enforces conflict prevention and supports recurring bookings with notifications.
Clinical documentation supports rich text editing, auto-save, version history, and AI-generated report accuracy.
AI features produce treatment suggestions and risk assessments with ≥95% reliability.
User authentication and authorization enforce role-based access control with session management and two-factor authentication.
Financial modules process payments through Stripe and PIX securely, reflecting accurate transaction records.
Teleconsultation sessions connect reliably with Jitsi technology and log sessions appropriately.
Patient portal provides secure and accurate views of personal clinical and scheduling data.
System performance loads pages within 2 seconds and supports 100 concurrent users with 99.5% uptime.
Data encryption, GDPR/LGPD compliance, and audit logs meet security and privacy regulations.
Backup routines run daily with tested data recovery processes and error handling robustness.
